name: smith standing calf raise (bar held behind)
description: A standing calf raise with the Smith bar held behind the body. It trains the calves.
instructions: Set the Smith bar at a height you can grip comfortably behind your body and stand with feet about hip-width apart.
Hold the bar behind you and rise slowly onto the balls of your feet.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels with control without bouncing your knees.
